dimensions.tax_creation: how the entity came to exist: factory-child (minter template), standalone-deploy (Maria or community direct deploy), fork-carried (Ethereum genesis state copy), bridge-wrapped (official bridge e-token), lp-token (PulseX pair ERC-20), external-system (fork-carried non-token infrastructure)
dimensions.tax_pricing: what a mint costs/produces: flat-1:1 (V1/V2 parent-parity), system-step (V3/Bureau x1.111B-unit step), self-scaled (V4 x own initial mint), fixed-supply (no mint path), capped-self-mint (1/call under <=1,111,111,111e18 cap), uncapped-mint (open mint), non-factory
dimensions.tax_redemption: exit path for locked parents: none-permanent-sink (V1), open-sibling-claim (V2 Claim(publish)), gated-sibling-claim (V3/Bureau; first withdraw kills claimability), self-redeem (V4), non-factory
dimensions.tax_parent_class: what the collateral parent is: fixed-reserve-tbill (V1), reserve-payment (FED/TBILL/MV), census-tt (another minter child), dev-contract (math family/AFFECTION), forked-asset, bridge-asset, lp-token (PulseX pair), minter-itself, external-token, none
dimensions.tax_admin: privilege keys: none-factory (treasury-era templates; bytecode-proven zero admin surface), renounced (owner == 0x0), live-owner-maria2, live-owner-other, none (no admin functions at all)
dimensions.tax_owner: current owner() value from the [chain] owner census; empty string when no owner function exists
dimensions.tax_admin_caps: what the owner key actually gates (code-level, from verified source / decompile): none | inert (only renounce/transfer) | owner-mint | owner-pool | owner-parameter | owner-withdraw | owner-pausable-withdraw | governance | inert-rescue-open | bridge-operator | unknown — see /kb/reference/admin-surface
dimensions.tax_liquidity: pool reality @ crawl block: pooled-live, pooled-dead-all (pools exist, none live), spine-only-paper (never had a pool), n-a (non-token); flags: lp-parent (parent itself is a PulseX LP), burnt-locked-50 (>=50% LP of one of its pools at dead sinks)
dimensions.tax_era: calendar/minter-generation window from block+timestamp thresholds (minter deploy blocks; 2025-04-16 crisis; 2025-07-01 long tail; old-atropa 2023-24; pre-v1 buildup; pre-fork = Ethereum-era origin, fork-carried at PulseChain genesis 17,232,969). External entities are dated in Atropa-relative eras by design — they matter here only as they relate to Atropa; fork-carried ones pre-date it and get pre-fork.
dimensions.tax_rng: relation to the MATH/RNG orbit: constructor-key-inert (TT _mintingKey, computed once, never used), infrastructure (MATH/RNG/math family), live-orbit-consumer (calls Random()/Generate() at runtime), none
dimensions.tax_class: principal mechanics class (see rules in kb-v2/taxonomy)
dimensions.tax_origin: core/community filter: core (Maria-deployed infrastructure + every factory child), core-factory (third-party factory children; mechanically derived from core), community (third-party deployments), external (fork-carried/bridge/outside)
dimensions.tax_alias_tshare_canon: TRUE iff address is on the dev-published t-share eco audit list (37); ALIAS ONLY - never a class-defining property
